snippet.title: Cupid Parasite | Announcement Trailer | Steam®
snippet.description:
【Official Website】
https://IFI.GAMES/cupid-parasite/

【Wishlist on Steam®】
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4245590/Cupid_Parasite/

The Parasite 5 are back—now on Steam! Get to know Lynette and her latest Cupid Corporation assignment in the Announcement Trailer. Cupid Parasite launches on Steam in 2026!

【About Cupid Parasite】 
Welcome to Cupid Corporation! –  Located in the glitzy and trendsetting metropolis of Los York, Cupid Corporation is a daring marriage agency known for its style and success rate.

Our heroine, Lynette Mirror, is Cupid Corporation’s top bridal advisor, whose job is to consult in-vogue singles to make their wildest romantic dreams come true! BUT she has one huge secret up her sleeve—she is none other than Celestia's Goddess of Love, Cupid!

After a family argument drives her to run away to the human realm, Lynette faces her biggest challenge yet: the infamous Parasite 5. Through a series of interviews and seminars conducted by Lynette, it was decided that the Parasite 5 would appear on the matchmaking share house TV program PARASITE HOUSE, which also serves to promote Cupid Corporation.

Will Lynette be able to live up to her name as top bridal advisor and Cupid, or will her dreams get cancelled?

【Key Features】 
From Boys to Men – Help the Parasite 5 find true love through "practice dates" to prepare them for their future partners. Maybe you'll find your own true love along the way?

Are U That Somebody? – Find your ideal love type through a questionnaire! Each Parasite 5 member has a different love type, which means the partner you end up with will depend on the results of the questionnaire. Want to explore the different love types? A second playthrough allows players to manually select a love type without completing the questionnaire, and may even unlock additional love connections... 

First Comes Love, Then Comes Marriage – The choices you make throughout the story can increase your Love Level with a character. If they like your answer, you'll experience a Love Surge. You can take the difficulty up a notch by turning off Love Surge animations in the menu. A specific Love Level is required to unlock a route's Best Ending! 

Go With The Flow – A Flow Chart is available to track your story progression. Jump between previously experienced scenes to revisit your choices. Use the Flow Chart to re-do routes and/or relive any memorable scenes!

#cupidparasite
